search-epic.title: Search relaunch
search-epic.body: New ranking, a proper empty state and a query parser that can be tested.

search-empty.title: Empty search results page offers no suggestions

unused-helpers.title: Unused currency helpers left in lib
unused-helpers.reason: The helpers were deleted in {commit} together with the old formatter; nothing references them any more.

hydrate-warning.title: Hydration warning on the home page

coupon-rounding.title: Coupon discount rounded per line instead of per order

routes-constants.title: Route paths are string literals in twelve components

wishlist-names.title: Unclear names in the wishlist reducer: data2, tmpList, flag
wishlist-names.body: Three variables in `reducer.ts` say nothing about what they hold. `data2` is the server copy, `tmpList` the optimistic one, `flag` marks a pending sync.

image-lazy.title: Product images below the fold load eagerly

flags-global.title: Feature flags read from window.__FLAGS__ all over the app
flags-global.body: 31 components read the global directly, so a flag can't be overridden in tests or stories. Route every read through `useFlag()`.

plural-concat.title: Cart summary builds plurals by string concatenation

checkout-epic.title: Checkout rewrite
checkout-epic.body: Move checkout to one state machine, fix the redirect bugs and cut `useCheckout` into pieces that can be tested on their own.

steps-switch.title: Checkout step logic is a switch on the step name

cart-drilling.title: CartPage passes six props through three levels
cart-drilling.reason: CartPage was rewritten on the cart context in {commit}; the props are gone.

use-checkout.title: useCheckout mixes state, validation and API calls in 600 lines
use-checkout.body:
The hook owns the form state, runs field validation and talks to three endpoints. Every checkout bug lands here, and the file has no tests.

Split into `useCheckoutState`, `validateCheckout` and `checkoutApi`.

reviews-xss.title: Review text rendered as HTML without sanitising

price-format-dup.title: Price formatting duplicated in CartSummary and OrderReview
price-format-dup.body: Both components format money by hand with slightly different rounding. Use `formatPrice` from `lib/format`.

analytics-switch.title: Analytics payloads built by a switch on event name strings
analytics-switch.body: A 14-branch `switch` in `track.ts` builds each payload; a typo in an event name silently sends an empty payload.

skeleton-flicker.title: Loading skeleton flickers on fast responses

footer-links.title: Footer links duplicated in two components

address-validate.title: Address step validates fields only on submit
address-validate.body: Postcode and phone errors appear only after pressing Continue, and then all at once. Validate on blur, like the payment step does.

vat-magic.title: VAT rate 0.2 hard-coded in three places
vat-magic.body: `tax.ts`, `CartSummary.tsx` and the order e-mail template each multiply by `0.2`. The rate for Ireland is already wrong.

session-quota.title: Storage wrapper swallows quota errors in Safari private mode
session-quota.body: `storage.set` catches `QuotaExceededError` and returns silently, so the checkout draft is never saved.
session-quota.reason: Fixed in {commit}: quota errors are reported and the draft falls back to memory storage.

carousel-keyboard.title: Image carousel can't be operated from the keyboard
carousel-keyboard.body: Arrow buttons are `div`s without a role; Tab skips the whole carousel. Found during the accessibility review.

holder-name.title: 3-D Secure redirect clears the card holder name
holder-name.body:
After the bank's 3-D Secure page redirects back, the payment form mounts again and the card holder field is empty. The card number comes back from the provider token, so people don't notice until the payment is declined.

The `key` on `PaymentStep` changes after the redirect, so all local state is lost.

- [x] Reproduce with the 3-D Secure test card
- [x] Find where the state is lost
- [ ] Keep the draft in session storage until the payment is confirmed
- [ ] Add an end-to-end test for the redirect round trip

grid-rerender.title: ProductGrid re-renders on every filter keystroke
grid-rerender.body: Typing in the price filter re-renders all 120 cards; each keystroke takes 90 ms on a mid-range phone. The filter object is rebuilt on every render.

idempotency.title: placeOrder retries without an idempotency key
idempotency.body: The client retries `POST /orders` on a timeout, and the API has no way to tell a retry from a new order.

double-email.title: Order confirmation e-mail is sent twice on slow networks
double-email.body: Customers on slow connections get two confirmation e-mails, and in two cases two orders. Waits for the idempotency key.

grid-dup.title: Product list is slow while typing a price
grid-dup.reason: Same problem as {original}: the grid re-renders on each keystroke.

cart-badge.title: Cart badge shows a stale count after switching tabs
cart-badge.body: The badge reads the count once on mount and ignores `storage` events from other tabs.

search-debounce.title: Search suggestions send a request per typed character
search-debounce.body: No debounce in `Suggestions.tsx`: typing a ten-letter word sends ten requests, and late answers overwrite fresh ones.

webhook-sig.title: Webhook signature checked after the payload is parsed

invoice-numbering.title: Invoice numbers can repeat across two workers

cron-tz.title: Nightly billing job runs in server local time

dead-flag.title: Dead feature flag ENABLE_V1_TAXES
dead-flag.reason: The flag was removed in {commit} along with the v1 tax code.

money-float.title: Amounts passed around as floats instead of integer cents
money-float.body: `Amount` wraps a `number` of currency units, so 0.1 + 0.2 shows up on invoices as 0.30000000000000004 before rounding.

refund-mutate.title: Refund handler mutates the incoming event

paypal-dead.title: Legacy PayPal adapter is still bundled
paypal-dead.reason: The adapter was deleted in {commit}; nothing references it any more.

usage-epic.title: Usage-based plans
usage-epic.body: Bill by metered usage instead of seats: reliable metering first, then plan limits.

metering-idem.title: Metering events accepted twice when the client retries
metering-idem.body: `POST /events` has no idempotency key, so a retried batch is counted twice and the customer is overcharged.

plan-limits.title: Plan limits hard-coded in PlanService
plan-limits.body: Limits for the three plans are numbers inside `if` branches. They have to come from the plan catalog before usage billing starts.

csv-export.title: CSV export breaks on commas in company names

retry-dup.title: Webhook retry policy copied into three handlers
retry-dup.body: Backoff, maximum attempts and dead-letter handling are written out in `stripe.ts`, `refund.ts` and `dispute.ts`.

shared-address.title: Customer and Account share one mutable address object
shared-address.body: Editing the billing address on the account silently changes the shipping address on the customer.

tax-chain.title: Tax lookup reaches through order.customer.account.region
tax-chain.body: `rates.ts` walks four objects to find the region; any missing link throws deep inside the tax calculation.

pdf-blocking.title: Invoice PDF rendering blocks the event loop
pdf-blocking.body: Rendering a 40-page invoice takes 1.8 s of synchronous work, and every other request waits. Move rendering to a worker.

fx-rounding.title: Currency conversion rounds differently from shop-web
fx-rounding.body: The API rounds half-even, the shop rounds half-up, so the invoice total differs from the checkout total by a cent.

focus-ring.title: Focus ring invisible on the primary button

iconbutton-copy.title: IconButton copies all Button variants
iconbutton-copy.body: Six variants and their hover states are duplicated instead of composing `Button`.

raw-hex.title: Components use raw hex colors instead of tokens
raw-hex.body: 40 components still use hex values, so the dark theme needs overrides in each of them.

tooltip-scroll.title: Tooltip closes on scroll inside a modal
tooltip-scroll.body: The tooltip listens to scroll on `window`, and scrolling a modal body counts as scrolling the page.
